name: Scattered to the Winds
text: Each enemy unit within 6" of the general loses 1 control score for each of your Ride the Hurricane abilities used this battle round (to a minimum of 1).

name: Wind Whisperer
text: Once per battle, in any hero phase, pick any edge to be your leeward edge. The edge does not turn.

name: Temple Guardians
text: While another friendly Infantry unit is within 3" of the general, the general and friendly Infantry units within 3" of it have Ward (5+).

name: Curved Shots
text: The general's shooting attacks can measure range and visibility from any point on your leeward edge as well as from the general.
